topicSections.title: Finding the picture in the frame

inlineContent.text: HeadwireCaptureModel holds everything about capture that can be decided without a capture card.
It describes devices and the formats they offer, picks the format to run when the person has not
chosen one, finds the Mac’s picture inside a padded frame, judges whether frames carry the range
their pixel format claims, keeps the per-card profile the app stores, and turns the frames recorded
during a calibration into a result. Everything here is plain value code that builds for iOS and
macOS and is tested against fixtures shaped like real cards’ format lists. It does not open a
device, run a capture session, or draw a frame: that is
